The zombie marble quarry can be built in the cliffs north of the [[cabin in the woods]]. It's an extension of the [[marble quarry]] but the zombies don't need any [[wood wedge]]s for their work.

After unlocking [[Building (Tech Tree)|zombie quarrying II]], you can build up to two mines: A left and a right variant.

'''Note:''' You don't have to build the player's [[marble quarry]] in the middle first.

==Miners==
To employ a [[zombie]], walk next to the wooden stand and hit "E" to put it to work. If you want to stop the mine, grab the [[zombie]] out of the wooden stand by walking next to it and hit "E" again.

The marble blocks are stored on the [[stone stockpile]] near the [[cabin in the woods]]. Without this, it won't work. This sign [[file:work blocked.png|work blocked]] on the blocks means, that the stockpile is full (or missing) and the work is blocked until some storage space is freed up (or constructed).
